text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
What they're sellin' over there is a tiger-print shirt!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "How rare~. Back home, I'd see aunties wearing this all the time, but nobody wears it around here."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There aren't any takoyaki stands around here, and nobody really talks about comedy either.
...Man, I miss home~

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no good!
I accidentally went all sentimental!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the word you're lookin' for is sentimental!
Nahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Man, that punchline fell flat.
Has being away from Kansai dulled my wit?
Weighed down by a lingering unease, Tamamo Cross seemed somewhat off her game during the subsequent training as well.
